title: Signed note helper and state-note CAS wrapper
spec: Add src/identity/notes.ts with two pure helpers over the existing primitives: signedNoteUrlParts(signer, ns, key, nonce, value) returning { did, sig, nonce, text } ready for setSignedUrl, and casNoteQuery({ ifAbsent?, if? }) returning the venue's query string ("if_absent=1" or "if=<value>") for the world-writable POST lane, which the paper rail and tclk state notes use. Validate names with NAME_RE; sweep values; reject a value over 4096 chars.
done: Both helpers produce byte-exact outputs for the golden vector and reject malformed names and long values.
